snippet.title: Hearts of Iron IV: Out now - Peace For Our Time
snippet.description:
Available Now! 👉 https://pdxint.at/4taYhsX

Imagine a world where the White Lion of Prague was prepared to face German agression. Explore that scenario in Hearts of Iron IV: Peace for Our Time, releasing on 22nd of April.

#hoi4 #heartsofironiv #grandstrategy
